verses: Yeh log aap say ghanimaton ka hukum daryaft kertay hain, aap farma dijiye! kay yeh ghanimaten Allah ki hain aur rasool ki hain, so tum Allah say daro aur apney bahumi taalluqaat ki islaah kero aur Allah Taalaa aur uss kay rasool ki ita’at kero agar tum eman walay ho

Bus eman walay to aisay hotay hain kay jab Allah Taalaa ka zikar aata hai to unn kay quloob darr jatay hain aur jab Allah ki aayaten unn ko parh ker sunaee jatin hain to woh aayaten unn kay eman ko aur ziyadah kerdeti hain aur woh log apney rab per tawakkal kertay hain
Jo kay namaz ki pabandi kertay hain aur hum ney unn ko jo kuch diya hai woh uss mein say kharach kertay hain
Sachay eman walay yeh log hain unn kay liye baray darjay hain unn kay rab kay pass aur maghfirat aur izzat ki rozi hai
Jaisa kay aap kay rab ney aap kay ghar say haq kay sath aap ko rawana kiya aur musalmanon ki aik jamat uss ko giran samajhti thi
Woh uss haq kay baray mein, uss kay baad kay uss ka zahoor hogaya tha aap say uss tarah jhagar rahey thay kay goya koi unn ko maut ki taraf haankay liye jata hai aur woh dekh rahey hain

Aur tum log uss waqt ko yaad kero! jab kay Allah tum say unn do jamaton mein say aik ka wada kerta tha kay woh tumharay hath aajaye gi aur tum uss tamanna mein thay kay ghair musallah jamat tumharay hath aajaye aur Allah Taalaa ko yeh manzoor tha kay apney ehkaam say haq ka haq hona sabit kerdey aur unn kafiron ki jarr kaat dey
Takay haq ka haq hona aur baatil ka baatil hona sabit kerdey go yeh mujrim log pasand hi keren
Uss waqt ko yaad kero jab kay tum apney rab say faryad rahey thay, phir Allah Taalaa ney tumhari sunn li kay mein tum ko aik hazar farishton say madad doon ga jo lagataar chalay aayen gay
Aur Allah Taalaa ney yeh imdad mehaz uss liye ki kay bisharat ho aur takay tumharay dilon ko qarar ho jaye aur madad sirf Allah hi ki taraf say hai jo kay zabardast hikmat wala hai

Uss waqt ko yaad kero jab kay Allah tum per oongh taari ker raha tha apni taraf say chain denay kay liye aur tum per aasman say pani barsa raha tha kay uss pani kay zariye say tum ko pak ker dey aur tum say shetani waswasa ko dafa ker dey aur tumharay dilon ko mazboot ker dey aur tumharay paon jama dey

Uss waqt ko yaad kero jab kay aap ka rab farishton ko hukum deta tha kay mein tumhara sathi hun so tum eman walon ki himmat barhao mein abhi kuffaar kay quloob mein rob dalay deta hun, so tum gardano per maaro aur unn kay por por ko maaro
Yeh uss baat ki saza hai kay unhon ney Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat ki. Aur jo Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat kerta hai so be-shak Allah Taalaa sakht saza denay wala hai
So yeh saza chakho aur jaan rakho kay kafiron kay liye jahannum ka azab muqarrar hi hai
Aey eman walo! jab tum kafiron say do badoo muqabil ho jao to unn say pusht mat pherna

Aur jo shakhs unn say uss moqay per pusht pheray ga magar haan jo laraee kay liye paintra badalta ho ya jo (apni) jamat ki taraf panah lenay aata ho woh mustasna hai. Baqi aur jo aisa keray ga woh Allah kay ghazab mein aajaye ga aur uss ka thikana dozakh hoga woh boht hi buri jagah hai

So tum ney unhen qatal nahi kiya lekin Allah Taalaa ney unn ko qatal kiya. Aur aap ney khak ki muthi nahi phenki balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa ney woh phenki aur takay musalmanon ko apni taraf say unn ki mehnat ka khoob ewaz dey bila-shuba Allah Taalaa khoob sunnay wala khoob jannay wala hai
(aik baat to) yeh hui aur (doosri baat yeh hai) Allah Taalaa ko kafiron ki tadbeer ko kamzor kerna tha

Agar tum log faisla chahatay ho to woh faisla tumharay samney mojood hua aur agar baaz aajao to yeh tumharay liye nihayat khoob hai aur agar tum phir o hi kaam kero gay to hum bhi phir o hi kaam keren gay aur tumhari jamiyat tumharay zara bhi kaam na aaye gi go kitni ziyadah ho aur waqaee baat yeh hai kay Allah Taalaa eman walon kay sath hai
Aey eman walo! Allah ka aur uss kay rasool ka kehna mano aur uss (ka kehna mannay) say roo-gardani mat kero suntay jantay huye
Aur tum unn logon ki tarah mat hona jo dawa to kertay hain kay hum ney sunn liya halankay woh suntay (sunatay kuch) nahi
Be-shak bad-tareen khalaeeq Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek woh log hain jo behray hain goongay hain jo kay (zara) nahi samajhtay
Aur agar Allah Taalaa unn mein koi khoobi dekhta to unn ko sunnay ki tofiq dey deta aur agar unn ko abb suna dey to zaroor roo-gardani keren gay bey rukhi kertay huye

Aey eman walo! tum Allah aur rasool kay kehney ko baja lao, jab kay rasool tum ko tumhari zindagi bakhsh cheez ki taraf bulatay hun aur jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa aadmi kay aur uss kay qalb kay darmiyan aarr bann jaya kerta hai aur bila-shuba tum sab ko Allah hi kay pass jama hona hai
Aur tum aisay wabaal say bacho! kay jo khaas ker sirf unn hi logon per waqey na ho ga jo tum mein say unn gunahon kay murtakib huye hain aur yeh jaan rakho kay Allah sakht saza denay wala hai

Aur uss halat ko yaad kero! jab kay tum zamin mein qaleel thay, kamzor shumar kiye jatay thay. Uss andesha mein rehtay thay kay tum ko log noch khasot na len, so Allah ney tum ko rehney ki jagah di aur tum ko apni nusrat say qooat di aur tum ko nafees nafees cheezen ata farmaeen takay tum shukar kero
Aey eman walo! tum Allah aur rasool (kay huqooq) mein jantay huye khayanat mat kero aur apni qabil hifazat cheezon mein khayanat mat kero
Aur tum uss baat ko jaan rakho kay tumharay amwaal aur tumhari aulad aik imtehan ki cheez hai. Aur uss baat ko bhi jaan rakho kay Allah Taalaa kay pass bara bhari ajar hai

Aey eman walo! agar tum Allah say dartay raho gay to Allah Taalaa tum ko aik faisla ki cheez dey ga aur tum say tumharay gunah door ker dey ga aur tum ko bakhsh dey ga aur Allah Taalaa baray fazal wala hai

Aur uss waqiah ka bhi zikar kijiye! jab kay kafir log aap ki nisbat tadbeer soch rahey thay kay aap ko qaid ker len, ya aap ko qatal ker dalen ya aap ko kharij-e-watan watan ker den aur woh to apni tadbeeren ker rahey thay aur Allah apni tadbeer ker raha tha aur sab say ziyadah mustehkum tadbeer wala Allah hai

Aur jab unn kay samney humari aayaten parhi jati hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney sunn liya, agar hum chahayen to uss kay barabar hum bhi keh den, yeh to kuch bhi nahi sirf bey sanad baaten hain jo pehlon say manqool chali aarahi hain
Aur jab kay unn logon ney kaha kay aey Allah! agar yeh Quran aap ki taraf say waqaee hai to hum per aasman say pathar barsa ya hum per koi dard-naak azab waqey ker dey
Aur Allah Taalaa aisa na keray ga kay unn mein aap kay hotay huye unn ko azab dey aur Allah unn ko azab na dey ga uss halat mein kay woh istaghfaar bhi kertay hun

Aur unn mein kiya baat hai kay unn ko Allah Taalaa saza na dey halankay woh log masjid haram say roktay hain, jab kay woh log uss masjid kay mutawalli nahi. Uss kay mutawalli to siwa muttaqiyon kay aur ashkhaas nahi, lekin unn mein aksar log ilm nahi rakhtay
Aur unn ki namaz kaaba kay pass sirf yeh thi seetiyan bajana aur taaliyan bajana. So apney kufur kay sabab uss azab ka maza chakho

Bila-shak yeh kafir log apney maalon ko uss liye kharach ker rahey hain kay Allah ki raah say roken so yeh log to apney maalon ko kharach kertay hi rahen gay, phir woh maal unn kay haq mein baees hasrat ho jayen gay. Phir maghloob ho jayen gay aur kafir logon ko dozakh ki taraf jama kiya jaye ga
Takay Allah Taalaa pak ko pak say alag ker dey aur pakon ko aik doosray say mila dey, pus unn sab ko ikattha dher ker dey phir unn sab ko jahannum mein daal dey. Aisay log pooray khasaray mein hain

Aap unn kafiron say keh dijiye! kay agar yeh log baaz aajayen to unn kay saray gunah jo pehlay ho chukay hain sab moaf ker diye jayen gay aur agar apni o hi aadat rakhen gay to (kuffaar) sabeyqeen kay haq mein qanoon nafiz ho chuka hai
Aur tum unn say uss hadd tak laro kay unn mein fasad aqeedah na rahey. Aur deen Allah hi ka ho jaye phir agar yeh baaz aajayen to Allah Taalaa unn aemaal ko khoob dekhta hai
Aur agar roo-gardani keren to yaqeen rakhen kay Allah Taalaa tumhara kaar saaz hai woh boht acha kaar saaz hai aur boht acha madad gaar hai

Jaan lo kay tum jiss qasam ki jo kuch ghanimat hasil kero uss mein say panchwa hissa to Allah ka hai aur rasool ka aur qarabat daron ka aur yateemon aur miskeenon ka aur musafiron ka, agar tum Allah per eman laye ho aur uss cheez per jo hum ney apney banday per uss din utara hai, jo din haq o baatil ki judaee ka tha jiss din do fojen bhirr gaee thin. Allah her cheez per qadir hai

Jab kay tum pass walay kinaray per thay aur woh door walay kinaray per thay aur qafila tum say neechay tha. Agar tum aapas mein waday kertay to yaqeenan tum waqt moyyen per phonchney mein mukhtalif ho jatay. Lekin Allah ko to aik kaam ker hi daalna tha jo muqarrar ho chuka tha takay jo halak ho, daleel per (yani yaqeen jaan ker) halak ho aur jo zindah rahey, woh bhi daleel per (haq pehchan ker) zindah rahey. Be-shak Allah boht sunnay wala khoob jannay wala hai

Jab kay Allah Taalaa ney tujhay teray khuwab mein unn ki tadaad kum dikhaee, agar unn ki ziyadti dikhata to tum buzdil ho jatay aur uss kaam kay baray mein aapas mein ikhtilaf kertay lekin Allah Taalaa ney bacha liya, woh dilon kay bhedon say khoob aagah hai

Jabkay uss ney ba-waqt mulaqat unhen tumhari nigahon mein boht kum dikhaye aur tumhen unn ki nigahon mein kum dikhaye takay Allah Taalaa uss kaam ko anjam tak phoncha dey jo kerna hi tha aur sab kaam Allah hi ki taraf pheray jatay hain
Aey eman walo! jab tum kissi mukhalif foj say bhirr jao to sabit qadam raho aur ba-kasrat Allah ko yaad kero takay tumhen kaamyabi hasil ho

Aur Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki farman bardari kertay raho, aapas mein ikhtilaf na kero werna buzdil ho jao gay aur tumhari hua ukhar jaye gi aur sabar o sahara rakho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa sabar kerney walon kay sath hai
Unn logon jaisay na bano jo itratay huye aur logon mein khud numaee kertay huye apney gharon say chalay aur Allah ki raah say roktay thay, jo kuch woh ker rahey hain Allah ussay gher lenay wala hai

Jabkay unn kay aemaal ko shetan unhen zeenat daar dikha raha tha aur keh raha tha kay logon mein say koi bhi aaj tum per ghalib nahi sakta, mein khud bhi tumhara himayati hun lekin jab dono jamaten namodar huen to apni aeriyon kay bal peechay hatt gaya aur kehney laga mein tum say buri hun. Mein woh dekh raha hun jo tum nahi dekh rahey. Mein Allah say darta hun, aur Allah Taalaa sakht azab wala hai

Jabkay munafiq keh rahey thay aur woh bhi jin kay dilon mein rog tha kay unhen to unn kay deen ney dhokay mein daal diya hai jo bhi Allah per bharosa keray Allah Taalaa bula shak o shuba)yeh ghalbay wala aur hikmat wala hai
Kaash kay to dekhta jab kay farishtay kafiron ki rooh qabz kertay hain unn kay mun per aur sareenon per maar maartay hain (aur kehtay hain) tum jalney ka azab chakho
Yeh ba-sabab unn kaamon kay jo tumharay hathon ney pehlay hi bhej rakha hai be-shak Allah apney bandon per zulm kerney wala nahi

Misil firaoniyon kay haal kay aur unn say aglon kay, kay unhon ney Allah ki aayaton say kufur kiya pus Allah ney unn kay gunahon kay baees unhen pakar liya. Allah Taalaa yaqeenan qooat wala aur sakht azab wala hai

Yeh uss liye kay Allah Taalaa aisa nahi kay kissi qom per koi nemat inam farma ker phir badal dey jab tak kay woh khud apni uss halat ko na badal den jo kay unn ki apni thi aur yeh kay Allah sunnay wala jannay wala hai

Misil halat firaoniyon kay aur unn say pehlay kay logon kay kay unhon ney apney rab ki baaten jhutlayen. Pus unn kay gunahon kay baees hum ney unhen barbaad kiya aur firaoniyon ko dobo diya. Yeh saray zalim thay
Tamam jaandaron say badtar, Allah kay nazdeek woh hain jo kufur keren, phir woh eman na layen
Jin say aap ney ehad o-paymaan ker liya phir bhi woh apney ehad o-paymaan ko her martaba tor detay hain aur bilkul perhez nahi kertay
Pus jab kabhi to laraee mein unn per ghalib aajaye unhen aisi maar maar kay unn kay pichlay bhi bhaag kharay hun, ho sakta hai kay woh ibrat hasil keren
Aur agar tujhay kissi qom ki khayanat ka darr ho to barabari ki halat mein unn ka ehad-nama tor dey, Allah Taalaa khayanat kerney walon ko pasand nahi farmata
Kafir yeh khayal na keren kay woh bhaag niklay. Yaqeenan woh aajiz nahi ker saktay

Tum unn kay muqablay kay liye apni taqat bhar qooat ki tayyari kero aur ghoron kay tayyar rakhney ki kay uss say tum Allah kay dushmanon ko khof zada rakh sako aur unn kay siwa auron ko bhi, jinhen tum nahi jantay, Allah unhen khoob jaan raha hai jo kuch bhi Allah ki raah mein sirf kero gay woh tumhen poora poora diya jaye ga aur tumhara haq na maara jaye ga
Agar woh sulah ki taraf jhuken to to bhi sulah ki taraf jhuk jaa aur Allah per bharosa rakh, yaqeenan woh boht sunnay jannay wala hai
Agar woh tujh say dagha baazi kerna chahayen gay to Allah tujhay kafi hai, ussi ney apni madad say aur mominon say teri taeed ki hai

Unn kay dilon mein bahumi ulfat bhi ussi ney daali hai. Zamin mein jo kuch hai to agar sara ka sara bhi kharach ker dalta hai to bhi unn kay dil aapas mein na mila sakta. Yeh to Allah hi ney unn mein ulfat daal di hai woh ghalib hikmaton wala hai
Aey nabi! tujhay Allah kafi hai aur unn mominon ko jo teri pairwee ker rahey hain

Aey nabi! eman walon ko jihad ka shoq dilao agar tum mein bees bhi sabar kerney walay hun gay, to do so per ghalib rahen gay. Aur agar tum mein aik so hun gay to aik hazar kafiron per ghalib rahen gay uss wastay kay woh bey samajh log hain

Acha abb Allah tumhara bojh halka kerta, woh khoob janta hai kay tum mein tawani hai, pus agar tum mein say aik so sabar kerney walay hun gay to woh do so per ghalib rahen gay aur agar tum mein say aik hazar hun gay to woh Allah kay hukum say do hazar ghalib rahen gay, Allah sabar kerney walon kay sath hai

Nabi kay hath mein qaidi nahi chahaiye jab tak kay mulk mein achi khoonrezi ki jang na ho jaye. Tum to duniya kay maal chahatay ho aur Allah ka iradah aakhirat ka hai aur Allah zor aawar ba-hikmat hai
Agar pehlay hi say Allah ki taraf say baat likhi hui na hoti to jo kuch tum ney liya hai uss kay baray mein tumhen koi bari saza hoti
Pus jo kuch halal aur pakeezah ghanimat tum ney hasil ki hai, khoob khao piyo aur Allah say dartay raho, yaqeenan Allah ghafoor o raheem hai

Aey nabi! apney hath talay kay qaidiyon say keh do kay agar Allah Taalaa tumharay dilon mein nek niyati dekhay ga to jo kuch tum say liya gaya hai uss say behtar tumhen dey ga aur phir gunah bhi moaf farmaye ga aur Allah bakhshney wala meharban hai hi
Aur agar woh tujh say khayanat ka khayal keren gay to yeh to uss say pehlay khud Allah ki khayanat ker chukay hain aakhir uss ney unhen giriftar kera diya, aur Allah ilm o hikmat wala hai

Jo log eman laye aur hijrat ki aur apney maalon aur janon say Allah ki raah mein jihad kiya aur jin logon ney unn ko panah di aur madad ki, yeh sab aapas mein aik doosray kay rafiq hain, aur jo eman to laye hain lekin hijrat nahi ki tumharay liye unn ki kuch bhi rafaqat nahi jab tak kay woh hijrat na keren. Haan agar woh tum say deen kay baray mein madad talab keren to tum per madad kerna zaroori hai, siwaye unn logon kay kay tum mein aur unn mein ehad o-paymaan hai, tum jo kuch ker rahey ho Allah khoob dekhta hai
Kafir aapas mein aik doosray kay rafiq hain, agar tum ney aisa na kiya to mulk mein fitna hoga aur zabardast fasad ho jaye ga
Jo log eman laye aur hijrat ki aur Allah ki raah mein jihad kiya aur jinhon ney panah di aur madad phonchaee, yehi log sachay momin hain, unn kay liye bakhsish hai aur izzat ki rozi

Aur jo log uss kay baad eman laye aur hijrat ki aur tumharay sath ho ker jihad kiya. Pus yeh log bhi tum mein say hi hain aur rishtay naatay walay unn mein say baaz baaz say ziyadah nazdeek hain Allah kay hukum mein, be-shak Allah Taalaa her cheez ka jannay wala hai
